notes.title: Schooling update & bundle release
notes.content:
Dear koi farmers,

Todays update improves the koi schooling behavior. Koi now group based on their color, which makes it easier to tell different breeds apart while they're swimming.

These screenshots show the improvement: the koi in the first image use the old schooling algorithm, and exactly the same group of koi swims grouped by color on the second one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39640199/fce461f795594c6bf6d29cd97232378b7393b666.jpg[/img]

The screenshots were not captured on a PC, but on the upcoming Nintendo Switch version, which will be released this year. We're making good progress, the game runs well, and we're currently working on porting the interface. Stay tuned!

The '[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50955]Chill Hoarding[/url]' bundle is out now, featuring both Koi Farm and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2407830]Trash Goblin[/url] — a cozy shopkeeping game where you collect, clean, upcycle, and sell trinkets to curious customers. That means that all koi farm owners get a nice discount if they buy Trash Goblin, or you can get both at a lower price.

Koi now group based on their color, which makes it easier to tell different breeds apart while they're swimming.

notes.title: Koi Farming Fest
notes.content:
Dear koi farmers,

To celebrate the Steam Farming Fest, koi farm is 40% off!

The game has also received an update:

[list]
[*] When the book is open, a button appears that takes the player to the settings menu, so a keyboard is no longer needed to play.
[*] The tutorial can now be skipped.
[*] A loading animation is added to the main menu.
[*] Some minor fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.content:
Dear koi farmers,

I've just pushed a small patch that prevents the shift and control keys from remaining in the "pressed" state when tabbing out of the game. This caused koi to be teleported (shift + click and control + click behavior) unexpectedly when tabbing back to the game window.

A small patch has been published today:

notes.title: Halloween update
notes.content:
Dear koi farmers,

To celebrate the Halloween sale, koi farm gets a special update today!

The most visible change is the autumn theme that will be active during the Halloween sale:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39640199/07b1907500774be6514c73e9470ae5651438ced2.png[/img]

On top of that, several smaller features have been added to the game:

[list]
[*] Control + click teleports a fish to the opposite pond, or to the big pond if the fish is in the river.
[*] Shift + click teleports a fish back into the river.
[*] Web (also called brindle) patterns can now stack.
[*] Stripe patterns can now stack.
[*] It is now possible to combine a ridge and a stripe pattern.
[/list]

The koi in the banner were created by koi farm players for our Halloween challenge; come meet us in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1518810/discussions/0/3117025249774719929/]the official Discord server[/url]!

tags.feature: Control + click teleports a fish to the opposite pond, or to the big pond if the fish is in the river.

Stripe patterns can now stack.
It is now possible to combine a ridge and a stripe pattern.

notes.title: Koi Farm patch notes
notes.content:
Dear Koi Farm players,

Thank you for playing! Since launch, several updates and patches have been applied already, in part thanks to all the feedback on the [url=https://discord.gg/bw3ZFe63Qg]discord[/url].

[list]
[*] Added Japanese translations.
[*] Added German translations.
[*] Added Turkish translations.
[*] Added Polish translations.
[*] Added French translations.
[*] Added menu option to override system language choice.
[*] Implemented autosave.
[*] Five colors have been added.
[*] Added an option to disable grass audio.
[*] The game now always uses a dedicated GPU if one is available.
[*] The game is now allowed to run in portrait mode (although it may hide the interface).
[*] Moving the volume slider all the way down now mutes all audio completely.
[*] The game uses higher quality audio files.
[*] A bug causing audio to crackle or play at low quality has been fixed.
[*] A bug that could crash the game when reaching the fish limit was fixed.
[*] A bug that caused grass audio to play when moving over water has been fixed.
[*] Mutation possibilities to make obtaining certain combinations easier have been added.
[/list]

Thanks for all the feedback!
